levels.A: One-digit addition with carrying (a, b in 1-9, a + b >= 10)
levels.B: Two-digit addition with carrying (a, b in 10-99, ones carry, sum <= 99)
levels.C: Two-digit subtraction without borrowing (a, b in 10-99, a > b, ones of a >= ones of b)
levels.D: Two-digit subtraction with borrowing (a, b in 10-99, a > b, ones of a < ones of b)
